summary: BrokerOS Extensions 3 (Commission Reminders) and 4 (Pipeline List view + Search, Commissions invoice search) fully tested end-to-end. Backend: 50/50 pytest tests pass (12 new tests for reminders endpoint shape, due_soon/overdue separation, sorting, received-exclusion, case+commission enrichment, invoice_number persistence). Frontend: Pipeline Kanban/List toggle works, search appears only in List view, partial+case-insensitive client/lender search works, empty-state with clear button works. Commissions reminders banner shows with correct yellow #FEF3C7/#F59E0B and red #FEF2F2/#EF4444 theme, dismiss hides banner, clicking reminder scrolls + applies bg-yellow-100 highlight that clears in ~2s, invoice generation downloads INV-2026-NNNN.pdf and on reload invoice_number is searchable.

issues: Search placeholder reads 'Search by client or lender name...' but spec mentions matching first/last/full name + lender. Current implementation does match all of these (client_name field is full name from backend), but placeholder could explicitly say 'client or lender' which it does — OK. No issue, just noting.

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/commissions/reminders performs an N+1 query pattern - for each non-received commission it issues separate find_one calls for case, client and lender. With many open commissions this becomes O(3N) Mongo round-trips. Consider aggregation $lookup or batching ids with $in.

Invoice sequence still not atomic (regression from iter 2). find_one then update_one in routes/commissions.py:323-346 leaves a race window. Concurrent invoice generation by same user can produce duplicate INV-YYYY-NNNN. Use findOneAndUpdate with $inc and upsert=true.

Pipeline.js list view does NOT receive a loading-skeleton for the list specifically when search returns 0 results from a still-loading state - currently handled by 'No cases in pipeline' fallback. Minor; tests pass.

Commissions.js fetchData triggers a 2nd large /api/commissions?limit=1000 call after every paginated fetch just for summary totals. This duplicates load and ignores backend pagination. Add a /api/commissions/summary endpoint.
filteredCommissions (Commissions.js line 225) re-evaluates on every render without useMemo. Same for filteredCases in Pipeline.js which DOES use useMemo. Minor consistency.

Both Pipeline.js and Commissions.js do client-side search only over the CURRENT page (limit=20 for commissions). If the matching commission is on page 2, the user won't find it via the search. Consider passing search as a query param to the backend, or fetching all on filter.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (Pipeline view toggle, search behaviour, Commissions reminders banner, dismiss, scroll+highlight, invoice download, invoice search)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed client/lender/case + 3 commissions (due_soon +7d, overdue -45d, received) for reminders verification, with full cleanup at end. UI test generated invoice INV-2026-0013 against existing seed James Wilson commission (e2e0a515) - invoice_number now persisted on that record. Invoice sequence for admin advanced to 13.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 + Ext 1-4 all working. Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/ has 50 pytest tests across backend_test.py (38) and test_extensions_3_4.py (12). New endpoints/contracts verified: GET /api/commissions/reminders -> {success, data:{due_soon[], overdue[]}}; due_soon items {id,client_name,lender_name,expected_amount,expected_payment_date,days_until_due 0-14}; overdue items have days_overdue>30; sorted asc; received excluded. GET /api/commissions/{id}/invoice now PERSISTS invoice_number=INV-YYYY-NNNN onto commission_records doc, exposed via list_commissions enrichment. Frontend data-testids confirmed: pipeline-view-toggle, view-kanban-btn, view-list-btn, pipeline-list-view, pipeline-search-input, pipeline-list-row-{id}, pipeline-clear-search-btn, reminders-banner, due-soon-panel (#FEF3C7/#F59E0B), overdue-panel (#FEF2F2/#EF4444), dismiss-reminders-btn, reminder-due-soon-{id}, reminder-overdue-{id}, commission-row-{id} (gets bg-yellow-100 for ~2s on reminder click), commission-search-input (placeholder 'Search by client, lender or invoice #...').
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. Implementation matches spec across all 5 review_request bullets and regression scope.
